site.headline: I think about products, markets, and the space where they meet.
intro: Hi, I'm Paul. This is where I write down product ideas, half-formed thoughts, and investment memos so I can see whether they hold up.
Most of it is a work in progress. If something here sparks an idea, reach out.

posts.title: Receipts for Everything
posts.summary: A single inbox that turns every purchase into a structured, searchable record for warranties, returns, and budgeting.

posts.title: An AI Chief of Staff for Small Teams
posts.summary: What if a 10-person company had the operating rhythm of a 1,000-person one, without hiring an ops team?

posts.title: In AI, Distribution Is the Moat (For Now)
posts.summary: When models commoditize, the winners are the ones who already own the workflow.

posts.title: Writing to Think
posts.summary: Why I publish half-finished ideas, and what I hope to get out of it.

posts.title: Sample Memo: A Vertical SaaS Roll-Up
posts.summary: A worked template for how I structure an investment memo: thesis, market, unit economics, risks, and valuation.
